spans.s: [तुष्-भावे घञ्] Satisfaction, contentment, pleasure, delight. -a. Pleasing, gratifying; तत्कर्म हरितोषं यत्सा विद्या तन्मतिर्यया [[

a. [तुष्-कर्तरि ल्यु] Satisfying, gratifying, pleasing. 
-णम् [भावे ल्युट्] 
__1 Satisfaction, gratification, contentment. 
__2 Anything that gives satisfaction, a gratification. 
-णी An epithet of Durgā.

a. (At the end of comp.) 
__1 Pleased with. 
__2 Gladdening, satisfying; अथानुरूपाभिनिवेशतोषिणा [[
